Task: Write an Ansible playbook installing and configuring a PostgreSQL 15 server: package install, pg_hba.conf with allowed CIDRs, postgresql.conf tuning for production, service start, and a database+user creation step.

- name: Install and configure PostgreSQL 15
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    pg_version: 15
    pg_port: 5432
    pg_listen_addresses: "0.0.0.0"
    pg_allowed_cidrs:
      - 10.0.0.0/8
      - 192.168.0.0/16
    pg_db_name: appdb
    pg_db_owner: appuser
    pg_db_owner_password: "CHANGE_ME_STRONG_PASSWORD"
    pg_max_connections: 200
    pg_log_min_duration_statement: "500ms"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Set OS-specific variables for Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pg_service_name: "postgresql"
        pg_conf_dir: "/etc/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main"
        pg_conf_path: "/etc/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main/postgresql.conf"
        pg_hba_path: "/etc/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main/pg_hba.conf"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Set OS-specific variables for RedHat family
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pg_service_name: "postgresql-{{ pg_version }}"
        pg_data_dir: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ pg_version }}/data"
        pg_conf_path: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ pg_version }}/data/postgresql.conf"
        pg_hba_path: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ pg_version }}/data/pg_hba.conf"
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Compute memory-based tuning values
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pg_shared_buffers: "{{ ((ansible_memtotal_mb | int) * 0.25) | int }}MB"
        pg_effective_cache_size: "{{ ((ansible_memtotal_mb | int) * 0.75) | int }}MB"
        pg_maintenance_work_mem: "{{ ([((ansible_memtotal_mb | int) // 20), 256] | max) }}MB"
        pg_work_mem: "{{ ([((ansible_memtotal_mb | int) // ((pg_max_connections | int) * 4)), 16] | max) }}MB"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages and repositories are present (Debian/Ubuntu)
      block:
        - name: Add PostgreSQL APT key
          ansible.builtin.apt_key:
            url: https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
            state: present

        - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository
          ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
            repo: "deb http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt {{ ansible_distribution_release }}-pgdg main"
            state: present
            filename: "pgdg"

        - name: Install PostgreSQL packages (Debian/Ubuntu)
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - "postgresql-{{ pg_version }}"
              - "postgresql-client-{{ pg_version }}"
              - "postgresql-contrib-{{ pg_version }}"
              - "python3-psycopg2"
            update_cache: true
            state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure required packages and repositories are present (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma)
      block:
        - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module streams
          ansible.builtin.command: dnf -y module disable postgresql
          args:
            warn: false
          register: disable_module_result
          changed_when: "'Disabled modules:' in (disable_module_result.stdout | default(''))"
          when: ansible_distribution_major_version is version('8', '>=')  # Only relevant for EL8/9

        - name: Install PGDG repository RPM
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}-{{ (ansible_architecture == 'x86_64') | ternary('x86_64','aarch64') }}/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
            state: present

        - name: Install PostgreSQL packages (RHEL)
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name:
              - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}-server"
              - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}"
              - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}-contrib"
              - "python3-psycopg2"
            state: present

        - name: Initialize PostgreSQL database if not already initialized
          ansible.builtin.command: "/usr/pgsql-{{ pg_version }}/bin/postgresql-{{ pg_version }}-setup --initdb"
          args:
            creates: "{{ pg_data_dir }}/PG_VERSION"
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Configure pg_hba.conf with allowed CIDRs
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ pg_hba_path }}"
        owner: postgres
        group: postgres
        mode: "0600"
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - pg_hba.conf
          local   all             postgres                                peer
          local   all             all                                     peer
          host    all             all                                     127.0.0.1/32            scram-sha-256
          host    all             all                                     ::1/128                 scram-sha-256
          {% for cidr in pg_allowed_cidrs %}
          host    all             all                                     {{ cidr }}              scram-sha-256
          {% endfor %}
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Apply production tuning to postgresql.conf
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: "{{ pg_conf_path }}"
        owner: postgres
        group: postgres
        mode: "0644"
        backup: true
        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED BLOCK: PostgreSQL tuning"
        block: |
          # Connection settings
          listen_addresses = '{{ pg_listen_addresses }}'
          port = {{ pg_port }}
          max_connections = {{ pg_max_connections }}

          # Memory settings (based on host memory)
          shared_buffers = {{ pg_shared_buffers }}
          work_mem = {{ pg_work_mem }}
          maintenance_work_mem = {{ pg_maintenance_work_mem }}
          effective_cache_size = {{ pg_effective_cache_size }}

          # WAL and checkpoint tuning
          wal_level = replica
          max_wal_size = 4GB
          min_wal_size = 1GB
          checkpoint_timeout = 15min
          wal_compression = on

          # Planner and I/O
          random_page_cost = 1.1
          effective_io_concurrency = 200

          # Extensions
          shared_preload_libraries = 'pg_stat_statements'
          pg_stat_statements.max = 10000
          pg_stat_statements.track = all

          # Logging
          logging_collector = on
          log_directory = 'log'
          log_filename = 'postgresql-%a.log'
          log_rotation_age = 1d
          log_min_duration_statement = {{ pg_log_min_duration_statement }}
          log_connections = on
          log_disconnections = on

          # Security
          password_encryption = scram-sha-256
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Flush handlers to apply configuration changes before DB/user creation
      ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers

    - name: Ensure database user exists
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: "{{ pg_db_owner }}"
        password: "{{ pg_db_owner_password }}"
        state: present
        role_attr_flags: "LOGIN"

    - name: Ensure application database exists and is owned by the user
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_db:
        name: "{{ pg_db_name }}"
        owner: "{{ pg_db_owner }}"
        encoding: "UTF8"
        lc_collate: "en_US.UTF-8"
        lc_ctype: "en_US.UTF-8"
        template: "template0"
        state: present

  handlers:
    - name: Restart PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ pg_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
        enabled: true
